_help: One plain sentence saying what each sub-topic (the catalogue's Sub Category) means. The key is category-slug/sub-topic-slug, the same as the web address (/explore/biography/prophets/ is 'biography/prophets'). Edit freely, then rebuild. A sub-topic with no entry here gets a standard sentence instead.
